parsed.summary: The schematic matches the design specification: the ESP32-C3 (U1) drives the TPS1H200 heater switch (U6) from GPIO1, the three MAX31855 thermocouple channels (U2/U3/U4) share SCK/SO with independent CS0/CS1/CS2, the TPS2121 power mux (U5) arbitrates +12V and +5V into VBUS, and the AP63203 buck (U8) with FB tied to +3V3 produces the 3.3V rail. No clear deviation from the intended design was found in the drawing.
